---
title: "Study Materials"
---

Self-test materials generated from the [Day 1](day1.qmd) and [Day 2](day2.qmd) notes. The flashcards and quiz are RevealJS decks built with the [quarto-flashcards](https://github.com/parmsam/quarto-flashcards) and [quarto-quiz](https://github.com/parmsam/quarto-quiz) extensions and open as their own slide decks — use the browser back button to return here. Teach-back prompts are a plain page, meant to be read and answered in writing rather than clicked through.

## Contents

- [**Flashcards**](study-flashcards.qmd) — one flip card per talk's key concept, Day 1 then Day 2; press `q` to flip, `t` to shuffle
- [**Quiz**](study-quiz.qmd) — multiple-choice questions across both days, with a running score; press `c` to check an answer
- [**Teach-Back Prompts**](study-teachback.qmd) — one open-ended synthesis prompt per talk, with a collapsed key-points answer to check against; tests understanding rather than recall

::: {.callout-note}
## Keep these in sync
All three are hand-written from `day1.qmd`/`day2.qmd`, not auto-generated — when new sections are added to either day, the flashcards/quiz/teach-back prompts should be refreshed to match.
:::
